notes: Profile B' with FP8 KV cache (--kv-cache-dtype fp8), the only change from the BF16 profile, for comparability with the kit's FP8 references. The planner keeps KV room for the same number of full-length requests, so the GPU memory FP8 frees goes to the GPU expert cache (18.73 GiB instead of 16.6 GiB per GPU); KV pool 270,930 tokens (1 full-length request; measured with --max-logprobs 100). New hardware class (PROMPT.md step 8): 2x AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 32 GB, tensor parallel 2, each card PCIe 5.0 x8 to the CPU (hw_bw: 28.8 GB/s H2D pinned at 1 GiB, 28.2 D2H; host memcpy 18.9 GB/s), Ryzen 9 9950X, 128 GB RAM, Samsung 9100 PRO (nvme_rand on the served n-gram file: 246k IOPS at 4 KiB / 32 threads, 8.9 GB/s at 128 KiB). Different checkpoint and engine from the target's known-good configs: tcclaviger/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MXFP4-FP8-GPTQ @ ab7c138a (MXFP4 experts, FP8 attention and MTP head, int6 n-gram table) on the pinned tcclaviger/vllm fork image (expert offload to pinned host RAM, n-gram table on NVMe), FP8 KV, MTP speculative decoding 3 tokens, CUDA-graph mode PIECEWISE (not eager). Two local changes to the image's memory planner, mounted read-only: the FP8-fitted per-token KV size is doubled for a non-FP8 KV dtype (BF16 cannot start at 262k without it) and RADIANCE_KV_RESERVE_SEQS reserves KV for N full-length requests. Tools: sweep.py, score_ref_panel.py, needle.py, probe.py and memwatch.sh were adapted for vLLM and AMD (SGLang /generate -> /v1/completions with token-id prompts and streamed usage; /server_info -> /v1/models plus the launch settings; panel via vLLM prompt_logprobs; API-key header; AMD VRAM and link width from sysfs); protocol, prompts, sampling and arithmetic unchanged; diff available. Panel: scored exactly with top-100 logprobs (22 of 60,020 reference ids fell outside the server's top 100 and got its 100th logprob); outside the band as expected, because the reference is the EXL3 3.05 bpw quantization and this is a different quantization of the same model; all 8 sequences agree 94-100 % on top-1, so no tokenizer mismatch. --max-logprobs 100 was added for the measured launch only (it changes what is returned, not what is generated). Needle at 254,747 prompt tokens, depth 0.8: pass. One C2 round ended one stream by the server's own repetition stop (finish_reason 'repetition'); no client caps. LOG_OUTPUTS on (request/output logging). The host also runs an agents VM (load average 13.6 and one kvm process at ~180 % CPU at the start of the M2 run), which also moves MemAvailable; no power, clock or fan changes. best_known.json has no entry for this card, so no early-exit gate applied.
